description.label: Description
description.value:
As you try to take a swing at him, your foe grabs your arm and uses your momentum to drag you toward him, and then roll backwards as he puts a foot in your stomach, hurling you over his head. You land with a crash, snapping your neck or crushing your skull! (If the GM judges that such a throw is completely unlikely, such as if you very considerably outweigh your foe, or have a very low centre of gravity, then he instead manages to get you so off-balance that you are still hurled to the ground and knocked unconscious, perhaps tripping you up as you stumble past him.)

Effects: You are dead due to an unfortunate and fatal landing! (If you are a Dwarf in full Plate, and thus extremely unlikely to be tossed, you instead gain @Condition[Unconscious].)
